samples.text:
**Hindustan Construction Company annual report, FY25**

HCC's standalone total assets as at March 31, 2025 were ₹8,743.37 crore [page 114](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=114).

HCC's FY25 report identifies enterprise-level and project-level risks, including operational, financial, contractual, order book, and project cost and time overrun risks, which the Risk Management Committee reviews regularly [page 52](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=52). Its financial risk disclosures cover interest rate risk on floating-rate debt of ₹251.18 crore on a consolidated basis [page 250](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=250), and foreign currency risk, tested against a 5% exchange-rate change [page 173](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=173). It also discloses equity price risk: a 10% movement in listed equity and mutual fund holdings of ₹49.56 crore would affect profit or loss by about ₹4.36 crore on a consolidated basis [page 252](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=252). Credit risk arises mainly from trade receivables, of which 84.37% were from government promoted agencies at March 31, 2025 [page 252](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=252). Liquidity risk, the risk of not meeting obligations on time, is managed through rolling cash-flow forecasts [page 175](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=175).

HCC is principally engaged in the business of providing engineering and construction services [page 199](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=199). The same note describes the consolidated Group as engaged in this business as well [page 199](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=199).

HCC's standalone total assets at March 31, 2025 were ₹8,743.37 crore [page 114](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=114). The same balance sheet shows total equity and liabilities of ₹8,743.37 crore for that date [page 114](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=114).

HCC's FY25 report describes a risk management framework that sorts risks into Enterprise Level and Project Level risks, with subcategories including operational, financial, contractual, order book, and project cost and time overrun [page 34](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=34). Its market risk disclosures cover interest rates, where the Group's floating-rate debt was ₹251.18 crore as at March 31, 2025 [page 250](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=250). They also cover foreign currency risk, with a 5% exchange-rate sensitivity [page 173](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=173), and equity price risk, where a 10% movement in listed securities would affect other comprehensive income by about ₹0.56 crore and profit or loss by about ₹4.36 crore [page 252](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=252). Credit risk is concentrated in trade receivables, of which 84.37% (₹2,639.02 crore) were from government-promoted agencies as at March 31, 2025 [page 252](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=252). Liquidity risk is managed by the treasury department through rolling cash-flow forecasts [page 175](https://hccindia.com/uploads/reports/0_14711100_1755498593_HCC_Annual_Report_2025.pdf#page=175).
